turns.doctor_question: Hello, and welcome. I'm Dr. [Name], a psychiatrist. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response:
Hi. Well, I guess what finally got me to come in is that work is starting to get pretty messed up. I'm an electrician, and lately, I just can't keep my focus on one estimate or code form anymore. 

It's like... I'll sit down to look at the paperwork, and a tool noise in the background, or a text message, or just some new idea I get about reorganizing the workshop completely pulls me off track. I just drop what I'm doing and move on to the next thing. Because of that, my jobs are starting to get mixed up, and I really can't afford to keep making mistakes like that.

symptom_reasoning.S001: The patient reports that their jobs are getting mixed up and they are making mistakes at work.
symptom_reasoning.S002: The patient explicitly states they cannot keep their focus on tasks like estimates or code forms.
symptom_reasoning.S008: The patient describes being easily distracted by extraneous stimuli, such as background tool noises or text messages.
symptom_reasoning.S039: The patient's attention is easily drawn to irrelevant external stimuli or unrelated thoughts, causing them to drop their current task and switch to the next thing.

turns.doctor_question: How long has this difficulty with focus and concentration been going on? Is this something new that's started recently, or have you struggled with staying on task for most of your life?
turns.patient_response:
It's definitely a newer thing. I've always been pretty good at keeping my head down and getting the work done. 

I'd say... well, it's been building up for about seven months now. That was right around the time we took on the mortgage for the workshop and bought all the new equipment. So, yeah, about seven months of it just getting harder and harder to stay on track.

symptom_reasoning.S031: The patient confirms a recent onset of difficulty with focus and concentration, stating it is getting harder to stay on track.
symptom_reasoning.S059: The patient acknowledges that for the past seven months it has been getting harder to stay on track, confirming difficulty concentrating.

turns.doctor_question: During these past seven months with all this energy and confidence, have you had to take time off work, or has anyone expressed serious concern about your behavior or judgment? Have things gotten so out of hand that you needed to see a doctor or go to the hospital?
turns.patient_response:
Well, I haven't had to go to the hospital or anything like that. But... things have definitely gotten a bit messy at work. 

I haven't taken time off, but my clients have started complaining lately. I guess I've been missing some details on jobs, and my scheduling has gotten all mixed up. And my apprentices... they just don't seem to trust my direction the way they used to.
